body: # Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain | Morningstar. *     Stock Market Update for the Trading Week Ended Dec. 12. 3.   Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain. *   The Morningstar US Market Index fell 0.55%. *   Growth stocks fell 1.12%, blend stocks gained 0.11%, and value stocks rose 1.19%. With investors rotating out of tech stocks, basic materials gained 3.06% and financial services rose 2.38%. This no-moat company with a 4-star rating has decreased 33.1% over the past 12 months. The stock closed the week at $12.15, trading at a 40% discount to its fair value estimate of $14 per share. The 4-star, narrow-moat stock has fallen 32.29% over the last three months and is down 64.13% over the past 12. AmeriCold finished the week at $12.73, trading at a 52% discount to its fair value estimate of $26 per share.

# Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq sink to cap brutal week for tech stocks. US stocks turned sharply lower on Friday, with the Nasdaq leading the way lower amid a broader rotation from tech to value names. The S&P 500 (^GSPC) dropped roughly 1%, one day after surging above the 6,900 level for the first time. Friday's moves cemented a brutal week for tech stocks in particular, with the Nasdaq down 1.6% and the S&P 500 down 1%. Investors are switching out of tech as fears about AI over-valuations get a reboot, as Broadcom (AVGO) followed Oracle (ORCL) in delivering earnings that left Wall Street wanting more. The rate cut also helped drive gold prices (GC=F) to touch a fresh record as the precious metal is set for its best year since 1979. Stocks retreated on Friday as investors rotated out of tech stocks on the heels of Broadcom's (AVGO) quarterly results. The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) fell 1.6% while the S&P 500 (^GSPC) retreated from a record, dropping 1%.
